description: This file defines a React component 'VCDetailsModal' and its associated subcomponents to display detailed information about a Verifiable Credential (VC), including overview, credential details, verification status, and raw data. It manages states for verification, copying, downloading, and handles loading/error scenarios. It interacts with external hooks and services for VC verification, chain retrieval, copying, and downloading.

methods.name: VCDetailsModal
methods.description: Main React component rendering a modal that shows details about a VC or VC chain, manages verification status, copy/download actions, and handles loading/error states.

methods.name: VCChainView
methods.description: Displays a list of VCs in a chain and allows selecting one for detailed viewing.

methods.name: SingleVCView
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a single VC, including overview, credential, verification, and raw data tabs, with actions for copying, downloading, and verifying the VC.
